purpose: y2s73-thumbfix: Nord2Metal = y2s63-vt23 with ONE fix: the odd-size YCbCr path's GPU copy (even-padded conversion -> the odd-sized texture Photos samples) passed rwa_texture_copy its source and destination the wrong way round (the library takes the destination first, as -copyFromTexture: calls it), so every odd-sized picture (Photos' 375x667 / 375x499 thumbnails) was never written and showed stale memory. All on the GPU; no CPU conversion. Installs over vt23 or gpuview (kept as Nord2Metal.pre-thumbfix; the undo restores it).
